title: The Order Block Myth That's Killing Your Trades (2026)
description: Everyone's hunting order blocks. But 80% of traders are marking them wrong — and smart money knows it. Here's what the R2F Trading system looks for instead before this week's CPI drop.
script: Stop marking order blocks. You're doing it wrong. And smart money is hunting you because of it. The myth: any bearish candle before a big move up is a valid order block. Wrong. Why it fails: 80% of those candles have NO liquidity behind them. Price ignores them completely. Smart money doesn't care about random candles. They care about WHERE liquidity was swept first. The truth: a real order block sits BELOW a liquidity sweep — then leaves a Fair Value Gap on the exit. With CPI dropping this week — this exact pattern is setting up on dollar pairs. Don't miss it.
